sourceIssues.title: GATE PI 2005 | Manufacturing Engineering Book Q5.67
sourceIssues.issue: The identical printed assertion–reason item has conflicting book keys (C in Welding and B in Non-traditional Machining). Conventional electron-beam welding uses vacuum primarily to prevent electron scattering; the vacuum also protects the weld from atmospheric contamination. B is the defensible interpretation, but the inconsistent source key is excluded from automatic scoring.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2022 · Q59
sourceIssues.issue: Only statement 2 correctly describes a variable-pulley stepless drive. Stepless drives allow continuously variable speed and can maintain appropriate cutting speed; statements 1 and 3 describe disadvantages of stepped drives. The printed options omit “2 only”, so this question is excluded from automatic scoring. Reference: NPTEL Manufacturing Processes II, Module 1, Lesson 2, https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/112105127/pdf/LM-02.pdf.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2008 | Manufacturing Engineering Book Q5.8
sourceIssues.issue: Only statement 1 is correct: 50 is the basic hole size; H indicates a hole-basis system, and 8 is the IT tolerance grade, not the fundamental deviation. No option gives “1 only”; the book prints an asterisk. This item is excluded from automatic scoring.

sourceIssues.title: GATE ME 2004 | Manufacturing Engineering Book Q7.42
sourceIssues.issue: The supplied book explicitly marks “None”. Work-hole limits are 20.010–20.050 mm and gauge tolerance is 0.004 mm. GO and NO-GO gauges require tolerance zones/limits, not just two nominal values; the printed alternatives do not state a consistent complete ISO gauge specification. Treat this as a source-key issue, rather than force a single listed answer.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2022 · Q150
sourceIssues.issue: Mechanization substitutes machine power for manual effort, while human control may remain; automation additionally replaces parts of the control function. The wording “by machinery as well as by hand” does not unambiguously distinguish these. Statement II also blends mechanization and automation. Without a verified official key, this assertion–reason item is retained with this explanation and excluded from automatic scoring.
